# Paradise Holidays Kerala

> > Kerala tourism specialist offering customized tour packages, houseboat experiences, Ayurveda retreats, and honeymoon holidays across destinations like Munnar, Alleppey, Thekkady, and Kumarakom.

Paradise Holidays Cochin, led by Ratheesh R. Nath and Sreedevi Ratheesh, provides comprehensive Kerala travel services including backwater cruises, hill station tours, wildlife experiences, and MICE corporate travel solutions. The company specializes in creating tailored itineraries covering Kerala's beaches, backwaters, and cultural attractions.
